The planned offering includes equity shares in MakeMyTrip India Ltd. By doing so, the company aims to boost brand recognition and motivate talent within the subsidiary. The funds raised will bolster MakeMyTrip's financial strength, paving the way for future development opportunities.

title: Sebi warns listed firms, regulated entities against rising 'Boss Scam' cyber fraud
description: Sebi has issued a warning to all regulated entities regarding a rising cyber fraud known as the 'Boss Scam'. In this scheme, fraudsters masquerade as senior executives to deceive finance teams into executing fund transfers. The scam employs various channels such as email, WhatsApp, and even sophisticated AI tools like voice cloning to execute their tricks.

title: Quote of the day by Joel Tillinghast: "People who have had success in other parts of their lives have difficulty accepting how much failure there is in the stock market"
description: Joel Tillinghast notes successful individuals struggle with stock market losses.  The stock market involves uncertainty, economic cycles, and investor sentiment.  Even experienced investors face setbacks and must learn from mistakes.  Retail investors should embrace patience and diversification for wealth building.

title: Tata Technologies Q1 Results: Profit rises 6% to Rs 180 crore
description: Tata Technologies has achieved an impressive 6.2 percent increase in profits for the June quarter, alongside a notable rise in consolidated revenues year-over-year. A strategic partnership worth USD 100 million with Tenneco showcases the company's dynamic approach. Furthermore, a leading Japanese automotive OEM has chosen Tata Technologies for a comprehensive vehicle engineering program, paving the way for robust future revenue growth.

title: India bonds sink on oil spike, index-entry uncertainty
description: On Friday, Indian government bonds underwent a notable drop, with benchmark yields marking the steepest weekly rise in the past eight weeks. The surge in oil prices and concerns over index inclusion led traders to exercise caution, reducing their risk exposure as they approached the weekend. This trend is indicative of wider economic challenges affecting global markets.

title: WeWork India posts Rs 4.3 cr loss in Jun quarter
description: In its latest quarterly report, WeWork India has revealed a net loss of Rs 4.30 crore, which is a notable reduction compared to last year's loss of Rs 14.10 crore. Total income for the April-June period rose to Rs 700.74 crore, while operational expenses increased to Rs 704.77 crore, illustrating the company's ongoing adaptations within the coworking sector.

title: Oberoi Realty Q1 profit rises 29% YoY to Rs 544 crore

The company's total income soared to Rs 1,361.69 crore in the first quarter of the fiscal year, illustrating a robust financial performance. Renowned as one of India's leading real estate developers, Oberoi Realty continues to thrive in a competitive market.
